REJECTED review finding R1-005 (add a nil-guard before h.telemetryReader call). The gateway's other required deps (acct, google, tesla, pool) are not nil-guarded either — they are contract-required dependencies injected by NewEngine/New; a nil reader is a wiring bug that should fail fast. Guarding only telemetryReader would be inconsistent with the module's dependency pattern. Reviewer flagged it minor and noted production is safe. No code change.

R1-004 rework design: extract a pure isStale(capturedAt, now time.Time) bool helper (returns now.Sub(capturedAt) > stalenessThreshold); mapVehicles calls isStale(snap.CapturedAt, time.Now()). Why: a literal time.Now().Add(-stalenessThreshold) exact-boundary test is FLAKY — nanoseconds elapse before time.Since runs, tipping past the strict >. Injecting now makes the at-threshold not-stale case deterministic. Alternative (accept flaky wall-clock test) rejected.
